section_header: AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM — Functional Test and Adjustment
title: Automatic Temperature Control

content.description: Control panel diagram showing Temperature Control Lever, Air Flow Control Lever, Blower Control Lever, and Air Intake Control Lever positions with automatic air conditioning settings and temperature scale
Close-up photograph of power servo unit showing white line position within orange and red areas marked on the stem

subitems: (a) Verify that the white line marked on the stem is positioned within the orange area on the power servo unit.
(b) If the white line positions are not in the orange area, adjust as follows:

content.description: Close-up photograph showing adjusting terminal with three wire connections labeled RED, WHITE, and ORANGE

subitems: (a) Normally the orange adjusting terminal is connected.
(b) If the white line on the stem is in the red area, change the connection to the red adjusting terminal.
(c) If the white line is within the white area, change the connection to the white adjusting terminal.

items.text: REINSTALL REMOVED PARTS IN REVERSE ORDER
